title: Why the Empire State Building has its own ZIP code
description: The Empire State Building is so massive that it operates under its own unique ZIP code. It is one of only 43 buildings in New York City with this distinction.
narration: EMPIRE STATE BUILDING IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a simple office skyscraper serving a neighborhood. It was actually closer to a private postal district. The sheer scale demanded its own unique mailing code. Because of its immense size, the structure holds the exclusive ZIP code 10118. This makes it one of only 43 individual buildings in all of New York City to have its own dedicated postal designation. A single building with its own private slice of the mail.
